about_the_game:
In Hidden Cats by Louisselle, you find yourself in your cozy room on a quiet night, sitting at your desk and about to open a beautiful art sketchbook by the artist Louisselle.

Right on the first pages, you come across beautiful illustrations depicting detailed landscapes and a curious little fact: the artist has hidden several adorable kittens throughout the artwork. Some are easy to spot, others not so much. The most delightful part is that each kitten you find fully reveals itself, making the scenes more and more enchanting.

There are four illustrations filled with kittens for you to explore in every detail, accompanied by a relaxing soundtrack that creates a cozy atmosphere where you can focus on your new-found skill: spotting excessively cute cats. It’s the perfect experience for those seeking peaceful moments with a generous dose of cuteness.

Features:

🎨 Pixel art environments by Louisselle

🐱 Cats, cats, and more cats

🎶 Relaxing and immersive soundtrack

⏳ Play at your own pace
